text: In response to your study requests dated May 13, 2002 for conducting genetic toxicology studies (mouse
lymphoma, micronucleus, cytotox, and Ames assays) and smoke chemistry studies for Project
Methylcyclopentenolone, IIT Research Institute (IITRI) is pleased to submit this letter proposal for your review
and approval. The proposed studies, with the exception of the micronucleus assay, will be conducted on five
types of cigarettes (three with various levels of methylcyclopentenolone, 1 Control cigarette, and the 2R4F
Research cigarette). For the micronucleus assay, only four types of cigarettes (all except the 2R4F) will be used.
The draft protocols will be submitted later for your review.
